Market today: Tech is still the main driver, but headlines are mixed. Bank of America's miss and Netflix layoffs are a drag, while Bending Spoons' surge shows some pockets of strength.

Your holdings: SMCI (-14.86%), MUU (-24.82%), SOXL (-47.26%), SPAL (-29.94%), and SMH (-9.45%) are all marked SELL/TRIM and are bleeding. Your leveraged ETFs are taking a beating.

Watch: The semiconductor ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and SMCI are the biggest pain points. Keep an eye on any further downside.

Bottom line: You're heavily concentrated in a sector that's showing weakness, and your leveraged positions are amplifying the pain.
plays: Trim SMCI if it breaks below 37.3.
Consider trimming MUU and SPAL if they continue to fall.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
